package.description: AI 原生知识库与印象笔记 / Obsidian 替代方案，支持多端瞬时同步与原生 MCP。

en-US.description: AI-native notes and knowledge base with instant sync and MCP.
en-US.longDescription:
EdgeEver is a modern, open-source notes and knowledge base workspace. It preserves the classic, high-efficiency three-pane productivity workflow (Tree View, Note List, Editor) while offering an open data architecture and seamless AI Agent integration for complete ownership and smart productivity.
EdgeEver can run within Cloudflare's free quotas with no server purchase or VPS maintenance. Users who prefer a VPS, NAS, or home server can deploy the same application with Docker.
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Toggle magazine covers per note and open chapter navigation separately. Covers show the note’s notebook name and refresh when notebook changes sync.
- In desktop ImgBed settings, load and pick an upload channel or type its name. Reopening a channel or model list preserves the value you typed. Thanks to @yulei666 in #827.
- On iOS, model detection can look up token limits in the public models.dev catalog when the provider reports none. Thanks to @yulei666 in #826.
- Android accepts WeChat ZIP archives shared alongside other files and shows release notes before opening the Google Play update prompt.
- Docker serves compressed, cacheable Web assets, reducing repeat downloads in self-hosted installations.
- Desktop System Info identifies when the Intel app is running through Rosetta on Apple silicon.
Related Issue: #831, #822, #829

zh-CN.author: tianma-if
zh-CN.description: AI 原生知识库与印象笔记 / Obsidian 替代方案，支持多端瞬时同步与原生 MCP。
zh-CN.longDescription:
EdgeEver 是一款现代化的开源笔记与个人知识库工作区。它保留经典高效的三栏工作区体验（目录树、笔记列表、编辑写作），同时具备完全开放的数据架构与原生 AI Agent 联动能力，让个人知识沉淀更轻量、更自由。
EdgeEver 可以免费运行在 Cloudflare 配额内，无需购买或维护服务器；希望使用 VPS、NAS 或家庭服务器的用户，也可以通过 Docker 部署同一套应用。
zh-CN.name: EdgeEver
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
- 可以按笔记开关杂志封面，并单独打开章节导航。封面会显示所属笔记本名称，并在笔记本变更同步后刷新。
- 桌面端 ImgBed 设置支持加载并选择上传渠道，也可手动输入名称。重新打开渠道或模型列表时会保留已输入的值。感谢 @yulei666 的 #827。
- iOS 检测 AI 模型时，若供应商未提供令牌上限，可从 models.dev 公共目录查找参考值。感谢 @yulei666 的 #826。
- Android 支持从多文件分享中导入微信 ZIP 压缩包，并会在打开 Google Play 更新提示前显示更新说明。
- Docker 自托管版提供压缩且可缓存的 Web 资源，减少重复下载。
- 在 Apple 芯片的 Mac 上通过 Rosetta 运行 Intel 版时，桌面端系统信息会明确标注。
关联 Issue：#831, #822, #829
